vibe_rationale: Community-run surf, music, film and art festival that takes over a beach village, a near SURPLUS peer with brands joining as Friends, but centred on one scene.
fit_notes: Mixed adult and family surf crowd with a natural spot for a recovery, hydration or sun-care space beside the comp; non-endemic brands already join as Friends, including a car dealer. It is a New Zealand event, so an Australian brand would need an NZ activation, but the Friends model is an open, low-cost entry.
